answer.title: Answer
answer.description: A whole number. Each game has its own bounds (PuzzleType.answer_min and answer_max): 0 to 10000 for missing-number, -1000 to 10000 for sequences. An answer outside the bounds of the puzzle's game is a 422.

next_step.title: Next Step
next_step.description: Index of the next step after a correct answer; null on the last step and after a wrong answer.

matched_rules.title: Matched Rules
matched_rules.description: Names of the known mistakes that give this answer. For analytics and development; not for showing to a child.

unrecognized.title: Unrecognized
unrecognized.description: Wrong, and no known mistake explains it.

reteach_topic.description: Where to step back to, if anywhere.

Equation.title: Equation
Equation.description: `left = right`, as tokens, so a frontend can draw the box as a real box.

position.title: Position
position.description: Place in the topic's list of error patterns, from 0. With the topic id it identifies the pattern across re-imports.

index.title: Index
index.description: 0-based position within that side's token list.

LinkedToken.title: LinkedToken
LinkedToken.description: Where a token sits in an equation: which side, and its place on that side.

MistakeRule.title: MistakeRule
MistakeRule.description: A known way of getting a step wrong. See rules.py for what each one computes.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Fixes the puzzle. Leave out for a random one.

focus.description: A mistake rule to target, as `focus` from /players/me/next gives it. ADD_VISIBLE, ANSWER_LEFT_BACKWARDS and POSITION_CONFUSION change the puzzle; any other rule name is accepted and has no effect. Never tell the child about it.

length.title: Length
length.description: Number of steps in the chain. Missing Number Chains only; null for a game without chains.

reason_code.title: Reason Code
reason_code.description: Which rule decided. `no_policy` means the game has no recommendation policy yet and this is its default, the same for every player.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, in a sentence for an adult. Never show it to a child.

focus_rule.title: Focus Rule
focus_rule.description: A mistake rule that keeps coming up, for example ADD_VISIBLE. Says what was noticed; `focus` says what to do about it.

focus.description: The rule to generate this puzzle with: pass it as `focus` to POST /puzzles/missing-number. Null when there is nothing to target, or when the previous puzzle was focused (at most every other puzzle is).

params.title: Params
params.description: The same recommendation, for any game: the fields to send with `level` in the body of POST /puzzles/{game}. For Missing Number Chains, `length` and, when there is one, `focus`.

mastery.title: Mastery
mastery.description: The mastery values the decision used: the recommended level's topics first, then everything else the player has practised.

mastery.title: Mastery
mastery.description: Estimated mastery per topic and level, from the first try at each step.

distance.title: Distance
distance.description: 1 for a direct prerequisite, 2 for one of its own, etc.

required_by.title: Required By
required_by.description: Id of the topic that directly needs this one. For a direct prerequisite that is the topic asked about.

game.title: Game
game.description: Which game the puzzle belongs to. Always sent; tells the shapes apart.

PuzzlePublic.title: PuzzlePublic
PuzzlePublic.description: A missing-number chain, as the browser gets it.

options.title: Options
options.description: The answer and three wrong answers, in an order that is fixed for the puzzle.

hint_tiers.title: Hint Tiers
hint_tiers.description: How many hint tiers can be asked for.

linked_token.description: The visible number that is the previous step's answer. Null for the first step. Says which one when the same value appears twice.

game.title: Game
game.description: Which game the puzzle belongs to. Always sent; tells the shapes apart.

length.title: Length
length.description: Number of blanks, which is the number of steps.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: The row, in order. Null where a term is blank. A blank stays null here after it is solved: the browser fills in what the child found.

SequencePublic.title: SequencePublic
SequencePublic.description: A row of numbers with one or two blanks, as the browser gets it.

index.title: Index
index.description: 0-based position among the blanks, in reading order.

position.title: Position
position.description: Which term of the row this blank is, from 0.

options.title: Options
options.description: The answer and three wrong answers, in an order that is fixed for the puzzle. May be negative.

hint_tiers.title: Hint Tiers
hint_tiers.description: How many hint tiers can be asked for.

in_scope.title: In Scope
in_scope.description: True for mathematics topics for ages 7-12. False for topics that are only here because an in-scope topic needs them first.

assessment_prompt.title: Assessment Prompt
assessment_prompt.description: The assessment prompt with the child's name filled in, or worded to 'you' when no name is given.

level.title: Level
level.description: Each level keeps its own estimate of the same topic.

p_known.title: P Known
p_known.description: Estimated probability that the topic is known, 0 to 1. From Bayesian Knowledge Tracing with hand-set (not fitted) parameters.

observations.title: Observations
observations.description: First tries the estimate is built from (at most 200).

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of topics matching the filters, before paging.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Checked answers on puzzles tagged with this topic.

first_try_correct_rate.title: First Try Correct Rate
first_try_correct_rate.description: Share of steps answered right on the first try, 0 to 1.

hints_per_step.title: Hints Per Step
hints_per_step.description: Hint tiers fetched, per step tried.

top_mistakes.title: Top Mistakes
top_mistakes.description: The three most frequent known mistakes, most frequent first.

research_note.title: Research Note
research_note.default: Agent-authored research; sources not independently verified.

in_scope.title: In Scope
in_scope.description: True for mathematics topics for ages 7-12. False for topics that are only here because an in-scope topic needs them first.

games.title: Games
games.description: The games this server has puzzles for.

UnknownToken.title: UnknownToken
UnknownToken.description: The box the child fills in.

NewSequenceRequest.description: The body of POST /puzzles/sequences. The seed decides everything but the level.

seed.description: Fixes the puzzle. Leave out for a random one.
